title: Therapeutic Interaction Features of AI Chatbots in Depression Interventions: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
quote: AI-driven chatbots showed a small-to-moderate reduction in depressive symptoms compared with control conditions, but the effect was not statistically significant
summary: Metanálise de 11 ECRs (2.220 participantes): chatbots de IA reduziram sintomas depressivos de forma pequena a moderada frente ao controle, mas sem significância estatística.
